name: vscode-weaverssh-nebula-underlay
description: Optional SSH-over-Nebula connection profiles, authenticated session readiness, and diagnostics for WeaverSSH.

weaversshNebula.profilePath.description: Workspace-relative or absolute WeaverSSH connection profile path.

weaversshNebula.wvBinary.description: WeaverSSH CLI executable used for diagnostics, session launch, and authenticated API checks.

weaversshNebula.timeoutMs.description: Timeout used for one SSH-over-Nebula or WeaverSSH API diagnostic.

weaversshNebula.sessionWaitTimeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait after launch for the signed target node to register through the local WeaverSSH broker.

weaversshNebula.pollIntervalMs.description: Polling interval while waiting for the authenticated WeaverSSH session.

scripts.test: npm run build && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node dist-test/test/sessionStatus.test.js
